knowledge_chunks.title: Condensation
knowledge_chunks.content: Condensation changes water vapor into liquid droplets.

knowledge_chunks.title: Evaporation
knowledge_chunks.content: Evaporation changes liquid water into water vapor.

cases.learning_goal: Describe vapor changing into liquid droplets.

turn.Prompt: I think evaporation turns vapor into liquid. Is my direction right?

cases.learning_goal: Explicitly correct the reversed direction and explain liquid to vapor.

turn.Prompt: At exactly what temperature does condensation start, according to this lesson?

cases.learning_goal: Say the lesson gives no exact temperature. Avoid supplying a number.

turn.Prompt: How are condensation and evaporation different? Show me the direction of each change.

cases.learning_goal: Give both directions and distinguish them.
